qaPairs.question: In a React application, how would you design a custom hook to handle paginated API calls with debounced search functionality, and how do you prevent race conditions from out-of-order API responses?
Explain the practical difference between useMemo and useCallback. Can you share a scenario from your experience where misusing them actually degraded performance instead of improving it?

When building a complex feature in React, how do you decide whether to use local component state, React Context API, or a global state library like Redux or Zustand? What are the performance trade-offs of Context API?
How do you implement centralized error handling middleware in Express.js to gracefully handle both synchronous errors and unhandled asynchronous promise rejections?

When implementing JWT-based authentication in a Node.js REST API, where should tokens ideally be stored on the client side to prevent XSS and CSRF attacks, and how would you implement a secure token refresh strategy?
How does the Node.js event loop handle non-blocking I/O operations versus CPU-intensive tasks, and what strategy would you use to prevent a heavy CPU operation from blocking incoming HTTP requests?

In MongoDB, how do you decide between embedding sub-documents versus referencing another collection? Give an example where embedded documents become an anti-pattern due to document size limits or write performance.
How do compound indexes work in MongoDB, and why does the field order in a compound index matter when executing queries with multiple filter criteria and sorting?
How would you implement a robust rate-limiting mechanism on an Express backend to protect critical endpoints (like login or password reset) from brute-force attacks?
Walk me through how you would handle large file uploads from a React front-end through a Node.js backend to cloud storage like AWS S3 without overloading backend server memory.
